meta.description: Keep your live website secure, updated, and monitored after launch. Kochi based team, monthly reporting, backups, and direct support on any platform.

body.text: Website maintenance services from Teknoppy keep an already-live website secure, current, and free of errors long after launch. Kochi businesses come to us when their site was built years ago and never touched again, when plugins and CMS software have gone out of date, or when nobody has been checking uptime and backups since the developer moved on. Every website maintenance plan starts with a health check of what is actually running on your site today before any update goes live.

sections.trustline: 120+ Websites Delivered · In Kochi Since 2018 · Kochi-Based Team, Direct Support Line

sections.h2: What Our Website Maintenance Services Include

items.title: Software and Plugin Updates
items.text: Website maintenance starts with keeping the CMS core, themes, plugins, and third-party integrations on their latest stable versions, tested in a staging environment before anything reaches the live site, closing the security gaps outdated software leaves open.

items.title: Uptime and Security Monitoring
items.text: Your site is monitored around the clock for downtime, malware injections, and SSL certificate expiry, with alerts sent the moment an issue is detected rather than discovered later by a customer.

items.title: Automated Backup and Recovery
items.text: Scheduled full-site and database backups are stored off-server as part of every website maintenance plan, so a hack, a failed update, or a server outage means a quick restore instead of a rebuild from zero.

items.title: Content and CMS Updates
items.text: Every plan includes a set number of monthly content edits handled directly by our team, whether that is a price list change, a new team member added, or a banner swap, with no ticket queue and no waiting on a developer.

items.title: Website Health Audit.
items.text: We review your current CMS version, plugins, hosting environment, and any past vulnerabilities before proposing a plan.

items.title: Maintenance Plan Setup.
items.text: You choose a monthly or annual website maintenance plan scoped to your platform, whether that is WordPress, a custom build, or an ecommerce store.

items.title: Scheduled Updates and Monitoring.
items.text: Core, plugin, and security updates run on a fixed schedule, backed by continuous uptime monitoring in the background.

items.title: Monthly Reporting.
items.text: You receive a plain-language report covering what was updated, what was fixed, backup status, and uptime record for the month.

items.title: Ongoing Support Requests.
items.text: Content changes and urgent fixes go through a direct request line, tracked from submission through to resolution.

sections.h2: Why Choose Teknoppy for Website Maintenance Services in Kochi

items.title: We Support Every Platform, Not Just One
items.text: Many agencies only maintain the platform they built. Our team supports WordPress, custom PHP builds, and ecommerce platforms alike, so we can take over website maintenance regardless of who built the original site.

items.title: We Report on Every Visit, Not Just Big Fixes
items.text: Every website maintenance plan includes a written monthly report of updates, fixes, and uptime, not a vague email saying everything is fine.

items.title: We're a Direct-Access Kochi Team
items.text: There is no offshore ticket queue between you and the engineer handling your website maintenance request, which matters most the moment something actually breaks.

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — Website Maintenance Services Kochi

items.a: It covers software and plugin updates, uptime and security monitoring, scheduled backups, technical bug fixes, and a set allowance of content edits each month, so a live website stays secure and current after launch.

items.q: How much does website maintenance cost in Kochi?
items.a: Cost depends on your platform, site complexity, and how often updates and content changes are needed, and is typically structured as a monthly or annual retainer rather than a flat one-time fee.

items.q: How often should a website be updated?
items.a: Security and plugin updates should be checked at least monthly, with critical patches applied within days of release. Content update frequency depends on the business, ranging from weekly to monthly changes.

items.q: Do you maintain websites built by another agency?
items.a: Yes, most of our website maintenance clients come to us with a site built by a previous developer or agency, and we begin every engagement with a full audit regardless of who built the original site.

items.q: What happens if my website goes down?
items.a: Uptime monitoring flags downtime the moment it happens, and our team investigates and restores service, using the most recent backup if needed, rather than waiting for you to notice and report it.

items.q: Is website maintenance different from web hosting?
items.a: Yes. Hosting is the server your site runs on. Website maintenance is the ongoing work of updating, securing, and fixing that site, and most businesses need both.

sections.h2: Ready to Put Your Website on a Maintenance Plan?

paragraphs.text: An unmaintained website is not neutral. It becomes more vulnerable and more outdated with every month it is left alone. A right-sized website maintenance plan fixes that before it turns into a security incident or a lost customer.
